predicates.title: Custom role grants roleAssignments/write (self-escalation primitive)
predicates.description: A custom role definition includes Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write (or a broader authorization write wildcard), allowing any holder to grant themselves Owner. Actions are flattened from permissions[].actions by the read-only runner.
predicates.recommendation: Remove authorization write actions from custom roles; restrict role assignment to User Access Administrators under PIM.

query.kql: authorizationresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roledefinitions' | where properties.type == 'CustomRole' | mv-expand perm = properties.permissions | project roleName = tostring(properties.roleName), roleType = tostring(properties.type), actions = perm.actions, subscriptionId

predicates.title: Custom role with wildcard (*) actions
predicates.description: A custom role grants '*' or a broad '*/write' action, effectively equal to Owner with less visibility.
predicates.recommendation: Scope custom roles to the specific actions required.

query.kql: authorizationresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roledefinitions' | where properties.type == 'CustomRole' | mv-expand perm = properties.permissions | project roleName = tostring(properties.roleName), roleType = tostring(properties.type), actions = perm.actions, subscriptionId

predicates.title: Excessive subscription-level Owner assignments
predicates.description: More principals hold Owner at subscription scope than expected, expanding blast radius. Owner count per subscription is summarized by the read-only runner. The agent confirms whether the holders are expected.
predicates.attack_vector: Any compromised Owner = full subscription control
predicates.recommendation: Reduce Owners; move to least-privilege roles and PIM-eligible assignments.

query.kql: authorizationresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments' | where tostring(properties.scope) matches regex '^/subscriptions/[^/]+$' | extend roleDefId = tolower(tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId)) | where roleDefId endswith '8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635' | summarize ownerCount = count() by subscriptionId, scope = tostring(properties.scope)

predicates.title: Service principal with Owner/Contributor at broad scope
predicates.description: A service principal holds Owner, Contributor, or User Access Administrator at subscription or management-group scope. scopeLevel is classified from the assignment scope by the read-only runner.
predicates.attack_vector: SP credential theft -> broad resource control
predicates.recommendation: Scope SP permissions to specific resource groups/resources; rotate credentials; prefer managed identities.

query.kql: authorizationresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/roleassignments' | project principalType = tostring(properties.principalType), roleDefinitionName = tostring(properties.roleDefinitionName), scopeLevel = tostring(properties.scopeLevel), principalDisplayName = tostring(properties.principalDisplayName), subscriptionId

predicates.title: Classic (co-)administrator assignments present
predicates.description: Legacy classic administrators / co-administrators retain full control outside modern Azure RBAC visibility.
predicates.attack_vector: Forgotten classic admin = hidden full-control path
predicates.recommendation: Remove classic administrators; manage access via Azure RBAC only.

predicates.title: Compute-attached managed identity holds a privileged control-plane role
predicates.description: A managed identity attached to a compute resource (VM, VMSS, Function App, Container App, AKS) is the direct assignee of Owner/Contributor/User Access Administrator at resource-group, subscription, or management-group scope. The read-only runner joins compute identity.principalId to role assignments.
predicates.attack_vector: Compromise workload (RCE/SSRF/runCommand) -> read IMDS token -> act as the managed identity with its privileged role -> lateral movement / escalation
predicates.recommendation: Scope managed-identity role assignments to the specific resources required; avoid Owner/Contributor at subscription scope for compute identities.

predicates.title: Compute-attached managed identity can read Key Vault / Storage data-plane secrets
predicates.description: A managed identity attached to a compute resource holds a Key Vault or Storage data-plane role (e.g. Key Vault Secrets User/Officer, Key Vault Crypto User, Storage Blob/Queue Data Contributor/Reader), enabling secret and data retrieval once the workload is compromised.
predicates.attack_vector: Compromise workload -> IMDS token -> read Key Vault secrets / storage data -> harvested credentials enable further lateral movement
predicates.recommendation: Grant data-plane roles at the individual vault/account scope only; separate duties so a single workload identity cannot read all secrets.
